page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.16xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs, utilizing the Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. With a 1.0 thread-to-core ratio, each vCPU maps to a dedicated physical core, eliminating resource contention from hyperthreading. The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating systems and data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and large memory capacity position this instance for workloads requiring consistent compute performance and substantial memory density without the overhead of local storage maintenance.

The ecs.r7.16xlarge is designed for memory-intensive enterprise applications. Suitable workloads include large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise resource planning applications, and memory-bound data processing tasks. The combination of 512.0 GB of RAM and 64 dedicated cores ensures stable execution for multi-threaded, memory-heavy enterprise software.
